_comment: Prices supplied by the thesis author (thesis section 3.5, table 3), excluding tax, as of 2026-10-03, USD. Free tiers and included allowances are ignored. Registry prices are per `unit` (GB = 1e9 bytes, GiB = 2^30 bytes) and converted to GB of gb_bytes bytes. Uploads (ingress) are free at these registries and are not priced.
runner_source: GitHub Docs: Actions runner pricing; GitHub Actions billing (accessed 2026-10-03)

registries.name: Amazon ECR
registries.note: download to the internet, US East (Ohio); free within the region

registries.name: Google Artifact Registry
registries.note: storage above 0.5 GiB; free within the same location
registries.source: Google Cloud: Artifact Registry pricing; Network pricing (accessed 2026-10-03)

registries.note: storage 0.00334 USD/GB/day above the included storage (about 0.10 per month); download above 100 GB/month
